dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a pronounced concave spline curvature from the apex to the posterior insertion point, characteristic of a falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The highest morphological point is classified as rounded with a moderate pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin contour slopes at an angle of approximately 45 to 50 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of maximum longitudinal base width to maximum vertical pixel height is approximately 1.4:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: The melon presents a highly convex, large-radius arc, creating a bulbous cranial silhouette.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: The visible beak is highly reduced in longitudinal length, presenting a blunt, thick profile extending minimally from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: A shallow obtuse interior angle is measurable where the vertical-sloping melon transitions into the short rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple fine, linear depigmented scratches are visible on the mid-lateral flank; a significant pale patch is present on the dorsal head region.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white/pale depigmentation on the anterior-dorsal surface of the melon contrasting with the primary grey-blue body coloration.
